data.title: 黄昏海滨天台的共享耳机
data.location: 俯瞰金色海湾的学院海滨观景天台
data.lighting: 金色落日海面逆光与暖橙长影
data.camera: 栏杆侧前方宽幅七分身
data.prompt: 2girls, seaside overlook railing, glowing golden sunset over ocean, windblown hair, shared wired earphones connecting them, warm orange backlighting, cowboy shot, (ayachi_nene, ayachi_nene_on_left, silver white hair, low twintails, purple eyes, ahoge, cream chunky knit sweater, caramel corduroy pinafore dress, leaning elbows on metal railing, wearing left earphone, gentle relaxed smile turning slightly right) BREAK (shiki_natsume, shiki_natsume_on_right, long black hair, two red hairclips, golden eyes, mole under eye, dark olive cropped utility jacket, black top, jeans, leaning shoulder against railing, wearing right earphone, calm soft smile looking toward viewer)
data.animaCaption: Leaning side by side along the coastal overlook railing linked by a single pair of wired earphones, Ayachi Nene on the left in a cream knit pinafore smiles softly while Shiki Natsume on the right in a dark olive utility jacket gazes calmly toward you. Blazing sunset gold over the bay rims their windblown hair.
data.promptProse: Composed wide along a sunlit metal overlook railing high above a shimmering sunset bay, Ayachi Nene and Shiki Natsume lean side by side sharing a single pair of wired earphones stretched gently between them. On the left, Nene rests her elbows on the rail in a cream chunky-knit sweater and caramel corduroy pinafore dress with a tranquil smile; on the right, Natsume leans coolly against the bar in a dark olive cropped utility jacket and jeans, meeting the viewer's eyes with quiet warmth as blazing amber sea light rims both of their wind-lifted hair.
data.story: 海风把两人的长发一起吹向晚霞。宁宁和夏目并肩靠在海滨观景栏杆上，中间牵着同一副有线耳机，谁都没有急着说话，只把最安静的一段黄昏留给了彼此。
